name: Shobek
overview: Shobek is a male biblical figure identified as a non-Levite leader mentioned in the book of Nehemiah. He is named specifically on the sealed document recorded in Nehemiah 10:24. His role as a leader outside the Levitical tribe highlights his distinct position in the post-exilic community.
namesAndTitles: The name Shobek means 'victor,' which is a proper name recorded in Nehemiah 10:24. This meaning reflects a victorious or prevailing character, though the name itself is not indicated as given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Shobek is a descendant of Jacob, establishing his Israelite heritage. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are noted in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shobek's significance lies in his inclusion among the leaders who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10, demonstrating his commitment to the community's renewed dedication to God's law. As a non-Levite leader, his presence underscores the broader leadership structure beyond the priestly tribe, emphasizing communal responsibility in the restoration period.
